subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers split this umbrella into separate TUI default-session, sessions_send channel routing, WeChat plugin/core identity, background-event isolation, and meaningful-activity ordering items, and which owner boundary should own each part?
rationale: The source gaps are real but the report crosses core Gateway/TUI behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, existing related issues, and product-level activity semantics; a single automated fix would mix unrelated owner decisions.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep the two existing focused issues for activity ordering and sessions_send routing, then create narrow follow-ups for TUI startup, WeChat session-family proof, and background-event isolation.

options.title: Keep umbrella as tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the high-level tracker and block implementation until maintainers can reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close only after focused fixes land
options.body: Close this issue only after linked focused issues or merged PRs cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep the two existing focused issues for activity ordering and sessions_send routing, then create narrow follow-ups for TUI startup, WeChat session-family proof, and background-event isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available product-boundary owner because the decision spans TUI behavior, session UX, and external WeChat documentation/product boundaries.
